petitions.name: petitions
petitions.sql: SELECT count(*) AS records,count(DISTINCT provider_id) AS documents,max(ingested_at) AS latest_capture,count_if(document_retrieval_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'downloaded') AS missing_downloads FROM optima_patent_petitions.source_observations_windows

reddit.name: reddit
reddit.sql: SELECT count(*) AS records,count(DISTINCT record_id) AS distinct_ids FROM optima_social_research.reddit_records

reddit-freshness.name: reddit-freshness
reddit-freshness.sql: SELECT count(*) AS records,max(verified_utc) AS latest_verified,count_if(verified_utc < 1794400436.052969) AS overdue_24h FROM optima_social_research.reddit_records

search.name: search
search.sql: SELECT source_id,count(*) AS records,max(observed_at) AS latest_capture FROM optima_source_readiness.source_samples_windows GROUP BY source_id

specialist-coverage.name: specialist-coverage
specialist-coverage.sql: SELECT source,dataset,count(*) AS windows FROM optima_specialist_inputs.source_coverage_windows GROUP BY source,dataset

specialist-observations.name: specialist-observations
specialist-observations.sql: SELECT source,dataset,count(*) AS records,max(ingested_at) AS latest_capture FROM optima_specialist_inputs.source_observations_windows GROUP BY source,dataset
